Class MesosGame

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Model.MesosGame
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameModel, Serializable
public class MesosGame extends Object implements GameModel
Concrete implementation of the MESOS game model. Manages the game state and implements all game logic.

    • getWinner

      public Player getWinner()
      Determines the winner of the game based on prestige points and food reserves.

      The winner is decided using the following tie-breaking hierarchy:

      1. The player with the highest number of Prestige Points.
      2. In case of a tie, the player with the most remaining Food units.

      Specified by:
      getWinner in interface GameModel
      Returns:
      the winning Player instance; null if the player list is empty or if a perfect tie exists after all tie-breaking rules are applied.
